newsitem.title: EGYPT: Netanyahu arrives in Cairo for talks with Mubarak.
newsitem.headline: Netanyahu arrives in Cairo for talks with Mubarak.

text.p: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu arrived in Cairo on Wednesday to a barrage of hostility from the Egyptian press, angered by his latest decisions on Arab East Jerusalem.
Prime Minister Kamal Ganzouri met him at the airport and a session of talks with President Hosni Mubarak was to start shortly afterwards at the Ittihadiya Palace, Mubarak's office in northeast Cairo.
